an3.44:1.1: 44 tīhi bhikkhave ṭhānehi kathā pavattanī hoti
an3.44:1.3: yo dhammaṃ deseti so atthapaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammapaṭisaṃvedī ca
an3.44:1.4: yo dhammaṃ suṇāti so atthapaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammapaṭisaṃvedī ca
an3.44:1.5: yo ceva dhammaṃ deseti yo ca dhammaṃ suṇāti ubho atthapaṭisaṃvedino ca honti dhammapaṭisaṃvedino ca
an3.44:1.6: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi ṭhānehi kathā pavattanī hotīti.
